name: radical
description: radical.tools monorepo: Studio, Hub, VS Code extension, website and shared packages

scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces --if-present && npm run test:tools
scripts.e2e: npm run build:web && npm run build:hub && npm run e2e -w @radical/e2e
scripts.docs:screenshots: npm run build:web && npm run build:hub && npm run docs:screenshots -w @radical/e2e
scripts.fuzz: npm run build -w @radicaltools/cli && node apps/cli/dist/index.js fuzz
scripts.check:architecture: npm run build -w @radicaltools/cli && node apps/cli/dist/index.js check --report reports --trigger pull-request
scripts.sense:pull-request: npm run build:cli && node apps/cli/dist/index.js sense run --trigger pull-request --out reports/metrics --context commit=${GITHUB_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}
scripts.verify: npm run check:workspaces && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:workflows && npm run check:workflows && npm run browsers && npm run test:reports && npm run sense:pull-request && npm run e2e && npm run check:architecture -- --metrics reports/metrics && npm run test:mcp-package && npm run test:launcher
scripts.hooks: npm run build -w @radicaltools/cli && node apps/cli/dist/index.js hooks install && node apps/cli/dist/index.js diff --save-base --quiet
